data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, the name Gittel is derived from the Hebrew word gadol, meaning great or mighty. The name Gittel is a diminutive form of this word, meaning small or precious one. In Jewish tradition, it is believed that the name Gittel was given to girls who were born during times of great adversity, as a reminder of God's love and protection. Gittel is also a popular name among Ashkenazi Jews.
